messages:
Rachel: opened PR #4802 — docs tidy: standardize call envelope, fix two dead anchors, update py/ts snippets, and add a tiny parse-fallback recipe. PTAL :eyes:

Diego: can you paste the broken anchors and the new envelope we recommend?

Rachel: broken: /docs/old-calls.md#response-forms and /docs/schema-patterns.md#nullable-lists. New canonical envelope: {\"action\":\"name\", \"args\":{}} — avoids mixing top-level result keys with call metadata. PR updates redirects and internal links.

Sam: good. Are the SDK helpers renamed? I can patch TS snippets.

Rachel: yes — TS: `callUtils.formatEnvelope(action,args)`, Py: `structured_output.envelope(action,args)`. Also added a short note: validate -> coerce -> fallback.

Nisha: parse-fallback recipe suggestion: 1) run JSON Schema validation; 2) coerce simple mismatches (e.g. string \"1,2\" -> [1,2]; single number -> [n]); 3) default + telemetry. Put runnable examples for calculator + todo-add.

Diego: I'll update TS examples and add a docs-test that mocks: proper envelope, stringified array, null -> [].

Sam: pushing tests now. Also add a tiny example parser that unwraps common wrappers like {\"result\": {...}}.

docs-bot: CI: build-docs ✅, link-checker ✅, docs-tests -> 1 failing (waiting on Diego's tests).

Rachel: once tests land I'll re-request reviews and merge. Planning a docs deploy after merge. Thanks! :rocket:
